title: Doberdó és az Isonzó pokla (Defeat & The Carnage)
grammar: Past Conditional Volna in Historical Context, War Obligation & Epochal Connectors

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can describe the fighting at Doberdó on the Isonzo front in 1915–1917.
I can say what would have happened if the fighting had gone differently, using volna.
I can use the words for the front, prisoners of war and casualty lists.
I can read a short account of the Isonzo battles and answer questions about it.
